Debate

Privacy Policy

Effective 7 October 2026 · Last updated 16 October 2026

Debate is an app for structured, timed debates between two people, chaired by an impartial mediator. This policy explains what the app collects, why, who else sees it, and how to get it back or get rid of it.

It is written to be read rather than skimmed past. If anything here is unclear, ask — the address is at the bottom.

The short version. Debates are live, and the audio is never recorded or stored. If both of you switch on argument scoring, your words are turned into text on your own phones and that text is scored; it is off unless you ask for it. There is no advertising, no tracking, no analytics software, and nothing is sold or shared with advertisers or data brokers. The app holds your account, your profile, and a record of which debates you took part in. You can delete all of it from inside the app.

Who is responsible

Debate is run by an independent developer, who is the data controller for the information described here. Contact: support@petconnect.store.

What the app collects

Your account

  • Email address — used to sign you in, to reset your password, and to reach you about your account. It is not shown to other users.
  • Password — stored only as a one-way hash by our authentication provider. It is never visible to us in readable form.
  • Date of birth — asked once when you register, to check you are 16 or over. It is not shown to anyone, not used for anything else, and cannot be changed from inside the app.

Your profile

  • Display name — chosen by you, shown to the person you are debating.
  • Code name — generated automatically at sign-up, such as SilentOracle4827. This is how friends find you. It is deliberately not your real name, and it is the only identifier a stranger can search for.
  • Subjects you follow — used to decide which questions appear on your home screen.
  • Profile picture — optional. If you add one, it is stored in a bucket that is readable by anyone who has the file's address, so that the person you are debating can see it. Treat it as public. You can remove it at any time.

Debates

  • Which debates you joined, which side you argued, and when they started and ended.
  • Your place in the queue while you are waiting to be matched. Removed once you are matched or leave.
  • Experience points and rank — one record per completed debate, which is what your rank is calculated from.

Live audio and video are carried directly between the two participants by our real-time provider. Your audio and video are never recorded, stored, or reviewed by us. When the debate ends, it is gone. Debates are private to the two people in them — there is no audience and no spectating.

Argument scoring, if you turn it on

There is one exception to the above, and it is off unless you switch it on yourself, in Profile → Scoring. Argument scoring is the only circumstance in which anything said in a debate becomes text.

  • It takes both of you. A debate is transcribed only if both participants have turned scoring on. If either of you has not, neither is transcribed — agreeing to be scored is not agreeing to transcribe the person opposite you.
  • The transcription happens on your phone. Your speech is turned into text by your own device, using the speech recognition built into it. The audio itself is never uploaded and never reaches us.
  • The text is scored, then discarded. When the debate ends, the text of what you said is sent to OpenAI, which rates your arguments for reasoning, support, engagement with the other person, clarity and fair conduct. We keep the five scores and a one-sentence summary. We do not keep the transcript.
  • It is scored against a rubric, not an opinion. The scoring judges how an argument was made, not whether it was right, and the side you argued is not a factor.
  • You see only your own scores. The other person never sees them, and you never see theirs.

Turning scoring off stops all of it from your next debate onwards. Scores already awarded stay on your account, because they are part of your rank; deleting your account deletes them with everything else.

Friends and private debates

  • Friend requests and friendships — who you are connected to.
  • Challenges — when you challenge a friend, the question you wrote and the side you chose. A question written for a private debate is readable only by the two people involved.

Safety

  • Blocks — who you have blocked. Nobody is told that they have been blocked.
  • Reports — if you report someone, we keep your report, who it was about, which debate it concerned, and anything you wrote, so that it can be investigated and acted on.
  • Suspensions — if an account is restricted, we record that and when it ends.
  • Agreement to the code of conduct and whether you have completed the introductory tour.

Notifications

  • A device token — only if you turn notifications on. It identifies your copy of the app on your phone so we can send it a notification, and nothing else. It is not an advertising identifier and cannot be used to track you anywhere outside this app.
  • What we send you — a record of the notifications we have sent, so that a weekly reminder is not sent twice.

Turning notifications off in your phone’s settings stops them. Deleting the app removes the token the next time we attempt to reach it.

Technical information

Our hosting and authentication providers keep ordinary server logs, which include IP addresses and timestamps, for security and abuse prevention. The app itself contains no analytics, advertising, or tracking software of any kind, and does not use advertising identifiers.

Why we use it, and on what legal basis

PurposeLegal basis
Creating your account and running debatesPerformance of a contract with you
Showing your name, code name and picture to the person you are debatingPerformance of a contract with you
Reports, blocks, suspensions and abuse preventionLegitimate interests — keeping the app safe and usable
Password resets and account emailsPerformance of a contract with you
Weekly debate allowances and rankPerformance of a contract with you
Keeping records of handled reportsLegitimate interests, and legal obligations where they apply

Who else sees it

We do not sell your information, and we do not share it with advertisers or data brokers. We use a small number of service providers, who process data on our instructions only:

ProviderWhat it handles
SupabaseDatabase, sign-in, and file storage — your account, profile and debate records live here.
LiveKitCarries the live audio and video of a debate between the two participants. No recording is made.
OpenAIGenerates the mediator's spoken lines from a fixed script written by us. No part of your speech, video or writing is sent.
BrevoDelivers account emails, such as password reset codes.
ExpoDelivers push notifications to your device, if you have turned them on. It receives the device token and the text of the notification.
AppleDistributes the app and handles any purchases. We never receive your payment details.

We may also disclose information where we are legally required to, or where it is necessary to investigate a serious safety problem.

Other people in the app

Someone you debate can see your display name, your code name, your profile picture and your rank. Someone who knows your code name can send you a friend request. Nobody can see your email address, your reports, your blocks, or your other debates.

Where your information is held

Our providers operate internationally, so your information may be processed outside the country you live in, including in the United States. Where information leaves the UK or the European Economic Area, our providers rely on recognised safeguards such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses and the UK International Data Transfer Addendum.

How long it is kept

  • Account, profile and debate history — for as long as your account exists.
  • Queue entries — minutes. Removed as soon as you are matched or leave.
  • Live audio and video — not kept at all.
  • Reports and the records of what was done about them — kept after an account is deleted, where that is necessary to enforce a suspension or to deal with a repeat problem. These are kept in the narrowest form that still serves that purpose.
  • Device tokens — until you turn notifications off, delete the app, or delete your account.
  • Server logs — kept by our providers for a short period under their own retention schedules.

Deleting your account

Open the app, go to Profile → Delete account. This removes your account and your personal information, including your profile, picture, debate history, rank, friendships and challenges. It cannot be undone.

Safety records described above may be retained where they are still needed. If you would rather do this by email, write to support@petconnect.store and we will action it.

Your rights

Depending on where you live, you have the right to ask us to give you a copy of your information, correct it, delete it, restrict or object to how we use it, or provide it in a portable form. You can also withdraw consent where we rely on it.

To exercise any of these, write to support@petconnect.store. We will respond within one month. If you are in the UK and are unhappy with our response, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk; if you are in the EEA, to your national data protection authority.

Children

Debate is not intended for children. You must be at least 16 years old to use it, and you are asked for your date of birth when you register. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone below that age. If you believe a child has created an account, write to support@petconnect.store and we will remove it.

Security

Access to your information is restricted at the database level, so that one account cannot read another's data even if the app were modified. Passwords are hashed, never stored in readable form, must be at least 12 characters, and are checked against databases of known breached passwords. Connections are encrypted in transit. No system is perfectly secure, but these are the measures in place.

Changes to this policy

If this policy changes in a way that matters, we will update the date at the top and, for significant changes, tell you in the app. Continuing to use Debate after a change means the updated policy applies.

Contact

Questions, requests or complaints: support@petconnect.store.
